info.title: Entrepreneur Mitra Backend
info.description: Production-quality backend for SIH26092: AI-Driven Scheme Matching for Marginalized Entrepreneurs (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment - MoSJE). Connects conversational voice interview, deterministic rule evaluation, transparent ranking, financial affordability calculation, and geo-spatial partner routing.
